                      launchField.querySelector('option:nth-child(' + i + ')').text = translations[language][labelTranslation][i - 1];
                    } else {
                      launchField.querySelector('option:nth-child(' + i + ')').style.display = "none";
                    }
                  }
                } else if (labelTranslation == "Contact_Form_Inquiry_Type__c") {
                  var inquiryField = formElem.querySelector('#Contact_Form_Inquiry_Type__c');
                  inquiryField.querySelector('option:nth-child(1)').text = translations[language][labelTranslation][0];
                  var numOptions = inquiryField.options.length;
                  for (let i = 1; i <= numOptions; i++) {
                    if (i <= translations[language][labelTranslation].length) {
                      inquiryField.querySelector('option:nth-child(' + i + ')').text = translations[language][labelTranslation][i - 1];
                    } else {
                      inquiryField.querySelector('option:nth-child(' + i + ')').style.display = "none";
                    }
                  }
                } else if (labelTranslation == "Webform_Notes__c") {
                  if (formID != 2689) {
                    formElem.querySelector('#' + labelTranslation).placeholder = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                  }

                } else {

                  formElem.querySelector('#' + labelTranslation).placeholder = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                }
              } else if (labelTranslation == "Button") {
                if (formElem.querySelector(".mktoButton")) {
                  formElem.querySelector(".mktoButton").innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                }
              } else if (labelTranslation == "PrivacyPolicy") {
                if (formID != 2662) {
                  formElem.querySelector(".mktoHtmlText").innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                } else {
                  const mktoHtmlTextElements = formElem.querySelectorAll(".mktoHtmlText");
                  if (mktoHtmlTextElements.length > 0) {
                    mktoHtmlTextElements[mktoHtmlTextElements.length - 1].innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                  }

                }
              } else if (labelTranslation == "InfluencerCopy") {
                if (formID != 2662) {

                } else {
                  const mktoInfluencerCopyElements = formElem.querySelectorAll(".mktoHtmlText");
                  //alert(mktoInfluencerCopyElements.length);
                  if (mktoInfluencerCopyElements.length > 0) {
                    mktoInfluencerCopyElements[0].innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                  }
                }
              } else if (labelTranslation == "ConsumerPanel") {
                if (formID == 2662) {
                  // Form 2662 has three native Marketo Rich Text blocks, in order:
                  //   [0] InfluencerCopy, [1] ConsumerPanel, [2] PrivacyPolicy.
                  // The ConsumerPanel block ships in English from Marketo; translate
                  // the middle one in place, like InfluencerCopy/PrivacyPolicy.
                  const mktoHtmlTextElements = formElem.querySelectorAll(".mktoHtmlText");
                  if (mktoHtmlTextElements.length >= 3) {
                    mktoHtmlTextElements[1].innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                  }
                }
              } else if (labelTranslation == "mktoCaptchaDisclaimer") {
                const mktoCaptchaElement = formElem.querySelector(".mktoCaptchaDisclaimer");
                if (mktoCaptchaElement) {
                  mktoCaptchaElement.innerHTML = translations[language][labelTranslation];
                }
              }
            }

            if (language === 'ja') {
              const countrySelect = document.getElementById('Country');
              if (countrySelect) {
                const options = Array.from(countrySelect.options);
                const japanOption = options.find(option => option.value === 'Japan');

                if (japanOption) {
                  // Remove it and reinsert right after the placeholder (first) option
                  countrySelect.removeChild(japanOption);
                  countrySelect.insertBefore(japanOption, countrySelect.options[1]);
                }
              }
            }

            if (language === 'ko') {
              const countrySelect = document.getElementById('Country');
              if (countrySelect) {
                const options = Array.from(countrySelect.options);
                // Marketo option values are the English country names; candidates
                // listed in case the underlying Korea value ever differs.
                const koreaValues = ['Korea, Republic of', 'South Korea', 'Korea'];
                const koreaOption = options.find(option => koreaValues.includes(option.value));

                if (koreaOption) {
                  // Remove it and reinsert right after the placeholder (first) option
                  countrySelect.removeChild(koreaOption);
                  countrySelect.insertBefore(koreaOption, countrySelect.options[1]);
